OpenMindAI v3.1.0-unofficial.1 — Mobile Preview

Status: UNOFFICIAL PRE-RELEASE / DEVELOPMENT PREVIEW
Desktop stable release: v3.0.0
Mobile preview label: v3.1.0-unofficial.1

This preview label documents the first public-facing OpenMindAI Mobile update line. It does not replace the v3.0.0 desktop production release and does not change the desktop package/application version.

OpenMindAI Mobile is a separately maintained Flutter application for Android and iOS. The mobile source code is not included in the public OpenMindAI desktop repository. This preview note describes the current mobile feature line so users can understand the direction of the project without treating it as a production mobile release.

Highlights

- Local-first Flutter client for Android and iOS.
- Local LLM inference through llama.cpp/lib_llama_cpp; no paid inference API is required for the local model path.
- Canonical mobile model catalog shared by onboarding, Model Manager, download/install, compatibility checks, routing, and inference.
- Hardware-aware model compatibility based on RAM, free storage, and CPU architecture.
- Explicit compatibility states for compatible, high-memory, not-recommended, insufficient-storage, and unsupported models.
- Large or license-sensitive models remain visible for manual installation without being automatically recommended on ordinary phones.
- Resumable model download flow with progress, transfer size, speed, retry/cancel behavior, and install verification.
- Direct-native local inference with a local llama.cpp server fallback path.
- Model-specific prompting/runtime handling for Qwen3, SmolLM3, Mistral, reasoning-oriented models, and other supported families.
- Android llama runtime packaging covers armeabi-v7a, arm64-v8a, and x86_64.
- Mobile CI validates Dart formatting, static analysis, tests, Android debug APK creation, and llama runtime ABI packaging.

Licensing and hardware notes

Model weights are not part of the OpenMindAI Apache-2.0 source license. Each model remains subject to its upstream license and usage terms. Meta Llama entries use the Llama Community License. Gemma uses Google's Gemma terms. OLMo and any model with additional upstream terms remain subject to those terms. OpenMindAI surfaces model license metadata instead of treating every weight package as Apache-2.0.

Very large models such as GPT OSS 120B, Gemma 27B, Mistral Small 24B, and other memory-heavy options may be visible in Model Manager but are not suitable for ordinary phones. Device checks may mark them unsupported or not recommended.

Release meaning

v3.1.0-unofficial.1 is intentionally an unofficial preview identifier. It should be published as a GitHub pre-release if binaries are shared. It is not a replacement for the stable desktop v3.0.0 release and should not be presented as a production-ready Android/iOS release until device coverage, signing, packaging, upgrade behavior, and release validation are complete.
